output.summary: A genus of flowering trees and shrubs, mostly from Neotropical and Afrotropical regions. Each fleshy fruit combines many smaller fruits, while the seed kernels are toxic. Seven named species and the atemoya hybrid are cultivated mostly for edible fruits, and several other species also bear edible fruit.
output.edibilityNote: Seven named species and atemoya are cultivated mostly for edible fruits; A. crassiflora and A. salzmannii also produce edible fruit.
